7523.text: Already playing, so this is mostly for the record. Sleeper (19.3) and the experts (QB8, about 19.4) agree, and the matchup and his rushing only add +0.2, for a My Score of 19.5. His range runs 14.6 to 29.8; his rushing is about a fifth of his points, which keeps the floor steady.

12527.text: Biggest question was health: RotoWire (ESPN) says he's active at New England after a pregame workout for the ankle. The experts like him more than Sleeper (RB13, about 13.0 vs 11.0), so the blend lifts him to 11.8. LV is a 3.5-point underdog implied for 21.0, which trims late carries (-0.3), for a My Score of 11.4. Ceiling 21.0.

12512.text: The game script is the drag: CLE is implied for only 18.0 and is a 2.5-point underdog, worth -0.7. The matchup helps back (+0.4): NYJ allow 25.3 pts/game to RBs, well above the 20.6 average. Sleeper (10.4) and the experts (RB19, about 11.6) are close, so My Score lands at 10.7. Range 6.0 to 18.6.

6801.text: The big split is experts vs Sleeper: FantasyPros has him WR67 (about 7.7), Sleeper 12.4, likely because of his groin/neck issue. RotoWire (ESPN) now says he's active vs Miami, so the experts' discount looks too steep. Blend starts at 10.5; a 25.8-point implied total helps (+0.4), but MIA allow just 20.4 pts/game to WRs (-0.5). My Score 10.6, ceiling 17.8.

8148.text: The best game environment on your roster: DET is implied for 30.0 at Arizona, worth +0.9, and ARI allow 37.1 pts/game to WRs (+0.3). Sleeper (10.0) and the experts (WR24, about 10.1) agree. His target share dipped to 13% the last 3 games (-0.2), and his beat writer Dave Birkett says the Lions need him to stop being boom or bust. My Score 11.0, range 5.8 to 20.5.

11604.text: Matchup is the story: NE allow only 5.9 pts/game to TEs (average 13.5), a -1.3 hit. Sleeper and the experts both have him at 15.8 (TE2), and the knee is fine: beat writer Paul Gutierrez says he practiced in full. My Score 14.3 is still an easy start; ceiling 24.1.

12506.text: Close call at FLEX vs Meyers and Croskey-Merritt. Fannin wins on the steadier profile: My Score 9.5, the higher ceiling (16.8) and the safer floor (5.9), and the experts like him more (TE8, about 10.3). The drag is CLE's 18.0-point implied total (-0.6) and NYJ allowing 9.9 to TEs (-0.4). Starting him is right, but by under a point.

4993.text: Bench. Sleeper says 8.2, the experts TE13 (about 9.4). The matchup helps (+0.5, MIA allow 18.6 to TEs) and CIN are implied for 25.8 (+0.3), but his target share fell to 6% the last 3 games vs 10% for the season (-0.3). My Score 9.2 with a wide range, 3.5 to 19.5.

3451.text: Sleeper (8.5) and the experts (K5, about 8.4) line up. TEN give up 10.2 pts/game to kickers vs an 8.3 average, worth +0.3, so My Score is 8.8. RotoWire (ESPN) notes he went 3-for-3 on field goals last week. Floor 5.9, ceiling 12.9.

HOU.text: Top defense this week. The Vegas line does the heavy lifting: TEN are implied for just 15.5 points, worth +1.4. Sleeper (10.8) and the experts (DEF1, about 10.4) agree, and My Score climbs to 12.2. Ceiling 21.4.

13264.text: This is a returns bet: Sleeper projects only 3.7 because it ignores his returns, about 84 kick return yards a game lately, worth +4.0 here. The experts sit higher too (WR45, about 7.6), so My Score is 9.3 with a 15.8 ceiling. That's just short of Fannin on expected points, ceiling and floor (5.3 here). Only 2 games of history, so his range is shaky.

12533.text: The other FLEX close call. Washington are 3.5-point favorites implied for 22.5 (+0.2), and the groin is cleared: RotoWire (ESPN) says no game designation. Sleeper (8.8) and the experts (RB29, about 9.5) agree, for a My Score of 9.3 and a 15.5 ceiling. Fannin edges him on both, so Fannin stays in by 0.8.

12536.text: Bench depth. Sleeper (6.8) already counts his kick returns, and the experts (WR66, about 5.3) are a bit lower. Only small tweaks (+0.4), so My Score is 6.6 with a narrow 4.4 to 9.6 range. He did have 85 yards on 3 catches last week, per RotoWire (ESPN).

12493.text: Best TE on waivers by My Score (8.8), but below Fannin and Gesicki. His snaps are rising, 52% the last 3 games vs 43% for the season (+0.4), and DEN allow 15.7 to TEs (+0.2). LAC are underdogs implied for 19.0 (-0.3). Sleeper (8.5) and the experts (TE21, about 8.6) agree.

11643.text: Free agent, and the boost is all returns: about 94 kick return yards a game lately, worth +4.0, which lifts him from 5.1 projected to 8.9. MIA are 7-point underdogs implied for 18.8 (-0.5). He's questionable with a foot injury per RotoWire (ESPN), so check before the 12 PM kickoff.

3634.text: Free agent. Sleeper (7.4) and the experts (WR47, about 7.4) match; punt returns (about 20 yards a game) add +1.3 for a My Score of 8.7. His target share fell to 14% the last 3 games vs 19% for the season (-0.2). Not a clear upgrade over your bench.
